name: Bounded snapshot GCRA reservation reconciliation
logic_name: Replay RPM and TPM reservation transforms and settle out of order without losing admission floors

test_list.description: Refunding an earlier same-time reservation restores only its unused cost while the later reservation remains charged.
An older refund is bounded by a later admission-time floor while preserving remaining live reservation debt.
Multiple reservations settle out of order and only actual unused costs are recovered.
A refund preserves both an intervening reservation and a later request's time floor.
Settlement after natural debt expiry reports no additional refund.
Concurrent reserve and settlement operations never admit more same-time tokens than the configured burst.
After warming fixed pools, repeated quota reserve, dispatch, and usage reconciliation allocate no heap blocks or bytes.
A full snapshot pool returns a deferred settlement and a later operation publishes and acknowledges the owned intent.
The next snapshot acknowledges the exact prior result before clearing it, and an old generation cannot release a reused intent slot.
A background admission folds a deferred refund before evaluating utilization-based shedding.
Compacting adjacent settled transforms preserves the later admission-time floor.
A refund does not reduce the tail below debt from a newer reservation.
An older refund cannot create capacity by crossing a later reservation's time baseline.
An earlier partial refund does not remove the later reservation's charged amount.

inputs.name: reservation
inputs.description: Generation-checked reservation identity backed by a preclaimed settlement intent slot.

output_description: Actual usage, confirmed refund, retained unused reservation, and whether a published intent remains deferred.
